body:
## What

Novel ML experiment landed entirely in experiments/ (pong plugin untouched, slots untouched per constitution): a fruitfly-CX ring attractor — ported 1:1 from SuperInstance/chiaroscuro PR #6 (tools/fly_cx.py, model flycx-v2-certainty-gated) — estimates the ball's arrival-y at the left paddle face from **sparse events only** (serve/wall/return), as runtime-defined sheet cells (sense.ring/state/project/update/predict). Ternary ψ dynamics (commit/reject/abstain), certainty-gated, fnv1a-64 receipt chain re-derived from GENESIS (3,585 rows).

## Measured (50 seeded matches/arm, fully deterministic — identical chain head across reruns)

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| H1 capture ≤12 ticks (left-bound serves) | **FAIL 20.8%** (gate ≥90%) |
| H2 re-capture ≤2 events after own-return | **FAIL 14.0%** (gate 100%) |
| H3 advisory ≥ reactive control | **PASS 94.0% vs 86.0%** |
| H4 advisory ≥55% | **PASS** |
| H5 honesty (advisory ≥1% of ticks, census) | **PASS 3.2% share** |
| determinism (M1 ×2, seeds 1–3) | **PASS identical head 035b0f940665b12c** |

No goalpost moves. FINDINGS.md carries the traced root cause: standing-mass dilution (mass≈12 vs 0.15/commit → ~0.75 err factor/event → ~9 events to converge; approach phases carry 1–4 events). Port-cadence mismatch, not a flycx defect. The advisory wins anyway — imprecise intercept-aim beats chasing ball.y when the ball moves 2.6/tick against a 0.85/tick paddle; value from predictive aim, separated honestly from estimator accuracy.

## Commits

- c3deef2 — pre-registration SEALED before any run (R1)
- 86014a8 — runner + receipt + FINDINGS + v2 pre-registration

v2 (error-scaled pull, the one-line dilution repair, unchanged H1–H5 bars) is sealed in experiments/predictive_paddle_v2.PREREG.md with falsifiable predictions — run lands next pulse under R8.

run_all gate: 6 plugins smoke-clean, 67 checks green. Citation of chiaroscuro PR #6 is load-bearing (referral edge candidate chiaroscuro-flycx → arcade-predictive-paddle per fleet weight law, PENDING on merge).
